title: Student Technology Device Program Replacement and Repair Price List
content:
The Student Technology Device Program prices each kind of repair, and the replacement of each device and accessory, by loan type. These are the full amounts in US dollars; how much of an amount a family is charged for a given incident is decided by the program's charging rules for damage, loss and accessories.

## Replacement costs (USD)

| Loan type | New device of the type | Charger | Protective case |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | 289.00 | 35.00 | 30.00 |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 289.00 | 35.00 | 30.00 |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 349.00 | 29.00 | 45.00 |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | 849.00 | 55.00 | 40.00 |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 849.00 | 55.00 | 40.00 |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | 129.00 | 19.00 | 0.00 (no case is issued) |

## Repair charges (USD)

| Loan type | Broken screen | Damaged keyboard or touchpad | Liquid damage | Damaged charging port or hinge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | 69.00 | 59.00 | 145.00 | 48.00 |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 69.00 | 59.00 | 145.00 | 48.00 |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 119.00 | 0.00 (no keyboard or touchpad) | 189.00 | 65.00 |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | 189.00 | 129.00 | 395.00 | 95.00 |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 189.00 | 129.00 | 395.00 | 95.00 |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | 0.00 | 0.00 | 129.00 | 0.00 |

## Notes

- A loan type with and without the Technology Protection Plan shares one price list for the same device: the two Chromebook loan types share the Chromebook figures and the two Windows laptop loan types share the Windows laptop figures.
- The keyboard or touchpad charge is 0.00 for devices without one; the iPad and the Mobile Hotspot carry 0.00 there.
- The case replacement cost is 0.00 where no case is issued, as for the Mobile Hotspot Loan.
- Each figure is the charge for one repair or one replacement item.
